decisions.evidence: A subgroup U of elementary abelian E is closed under all integer powers; canonical scalar multiplication is x^a, so U is a vector subspace. Basis extension then proves maximal means codimension one. A nonzero functional is surjective by scaling any vector with nonzero image; kernel plus a unit-image vector is a basis. Correspondence transfers maximality, with E=0 giving neither maximal subgroups nor nonzero maps. Reader/refuter correctly notice this implicit one-line scalar closure; confirmed nonfatal polish.
